अश् (न, ऊ, ङ) अश्नुते 5.
d. To per-
vade; to crowd, to heap.

अष् (ञ) असति ते 1.
c. To go; to
take or receive; to shine.

अस् (ञ) असति-ते 1.
c. To go; to
take or receive; to shine.

अस् (य, उ, इर) अस्यति 4.
a. to throw.
With अनु to sit; with अप^1 to quit; with
उद् to leave; with नि to deposit;
with निर् to expel, to refute; with
[]
प्र to reject; with वि to divide;
with सं to collect; with परि and
उप to sit round; with वि and आ
to class; with सं and नि to aban-
don the world.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20200322. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/202.

आस् (ल-ङ-ञि) आस्ते 2.
d. irr. To
sit. With अधि to inhabit, to pre-
side, to mistake; with अभि to
sit to, or learn; with उत् to leave,
to agitate; with उप to worship;
with निर् to expel; with प्र and
निर to refute or invalidate.
